proc_p: Hallway storage usually takes four to six weeks to make once you approve the design.
steps: We measure the hall, the stairs and any boot room, and ask about coats, shoes and bags.
You see the storage in 3D, including any under-stairs drawers or bench seat, with an itemised quote.
Every piece is made to fit your hall exactly in our workshop.
We fit it tight to the walls and stairs, backed by our 12-month guarantee.
book_p: Send a photo of your hall on WhatsApp or book a visit. We’ll measure up and send you a 3D design with an itemised quote.
